text: FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN OF THE GOMARANKADAWALA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66B (2) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 16 OF 2017
WHEREAS the office of Chairman of Gomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death.

And whereas the Secretary of the Jathika Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Rangika Pragath Dharmadasa the former Chairman belonged, was required by me under Section 66B (2) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon the member of that Gomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party who shall be declared elected as Chairman within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the Secretary of aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Ranas-inghage Kenaman Disanayaka to fill vacancy;

Therefore I, Selladhore Kaliuganathan Deva Neranjan Returning Officer of Gomarankadawala Pradesbiya Sabha acting in terms of Section 66B (2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) as amended by Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 16 of 2017 do hereby declare Ranasinghage Kenaman Disanayaka elected as Chairman of theGomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha.
S. K. Deva Neranjan, Returning Officer, Gomarankadawala Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office,Trincomalee,29th December, 2025.
